_meta.stig: Application Security and Development Security Technical Implementation Guide
_meta.description: Maps Epyon scan tool results to APPSTIG control statuses. Controls with tool_mappings have their status determined by scan output. All others default to default_status.

V-222444.title: The application must not write sensitive data into the application logs.
V-222444.default_evidence: Review application log output to confirm no secrets, passwords, API keys, or credentials are written to logs.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: TruffleHog detected secrets or credentials in repository artifacts. Review and rotate exposed secrets and ensure they are not written to application logs.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: TruffleHog secret detection scan completed with no secrets found in repository artifacts.

V-222515.title: An application vulnerability assessment must be conducted.
V-222515.default_evidence: No vulnerability scanner results available. Run Grype or Trivy to perform vulnerability assessment.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Grype vulnerability scan found unresolved CVEs. Remediate identified vulnerabilities and conduct follow-up assessment.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Grype vulnerability assessment completed. No vulnerabilities found in application dependencies.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Trivy vulnerability scan found unresolved CVEs. Remediate identified vulnerabilities and conduct follow-up assessment.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Trivy vulnerability assessment completed. No vulnerabilities found in application container image.

V-222430.title: The application must execute without excessive account permissions.
V-222430.default_evidence: Review container and process configurations to confirm no excessive privileges are granted.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis detected privilege-related misconfigurations. Review and remediate excessive permission grants in container and infrastructure configurations.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis completed with no privilege escalation or excessive permission issues detected.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Trivy misconfiguration scan detected containers running with excessive privileges. Review and remediate.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Trivy misconfiguration scan completed. No containers running with excessive privileges detected.

V-222518.title: The application must be configured to disable non-essential capabilities.
V-222518.default_evidence: Review application and container configurations to confirm only required capabilities are enabled.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis detected non-essential capabilities or services enabled. Review and disable unnecessary capabilities.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis completed. No unnecessary capabilities or services detected in infrastructure configurations.

V-222519.title: The application must be configured to use only functions, ports, and protocols permitted in the PPSM CAL.
V-222519.default_evidence: Review application network configuration to confirm only approved ports and protocols are in use.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis detected potentially non-standard port or protocol configurations. Review against PPSM CAL.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis completed with no non-standard port or protocol configurations detected.

V-222511.title: The application must enforce access restrictions associated with changes to application configuration.
V-222511.default_evidence: Review configuration management controls to confirm only authorized users can modify application configuration.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis detected configuration access control issues. Review and enforce proper access restrictions on configuration files.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis completed. No configuration access control issues detected.

V-222427.title: The application must enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system.
V-222427.default_evidence: Review network policies and container configurations to confirm information flow controls are enforced.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis detected missing or misconfigured network policy or information flow controls.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis completed. Information flow control configurations appear correct.

V-222517.title: The application must employ a deny-all, permit-by-exception (whitelist) policy to allow the execution of authorized software programs.
V-222517.default_evidence: Review application allow-listing configuration to confirm only authorized software is permitted to execute.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis detected missing application allow-listing controls.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis completed. Manual review required to confirm deny-all, permit-by-exception policy is in place.

V-222612.title: The application must protect against malicious code.
V-222612.default_evidence: No malware scan results available. Run ClamAV to scan for malicious code.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: ClamAV malware scan detected malicious code or signatures. Investigate and remediate immediately.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: ClamAV malware scan completed. No malicious code or virus signatures detected in application files.

V-222610.title: The application must not be subject to denial of service.
V-222610.default_evidence: Review application resiliency and rate limiting configurations.

V-222608.title: Application code must be kept up-to-date with the latest software patches.
V-222608.default_evidence: No end-of-life or patch status data available.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Xeol EOL detection found end-of-life components. Update or replace all end-of-life software packages.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Xeol EOL detection completed. No end-of-life software components detected.

V-222624.title: The ISSO must ensure active vulnerability testing is performed.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Active vulnerability testing performed by Grype. CVE findings identified; remediation required separately.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Active vulnerability testing performed by Grype. No vulnerabilities found.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Active vulnerability testing performed by Trivy. CVE findings identified; remediation required separately.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Active vulnerability testing performed by Trivy. No vulnerabilities found.

V-222609.title: The application must be free of vulnerabilities that pose an unacceptable risk when determined by the AO.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Grype detected vulnerabilities that may pose unacceptable risk. AO review and remediation required.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Grype vulnerability scan completed. No high-risk vulnerabilities detected.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Trivy detected vulnerabilities that may pose unacceptable risk. AO review and remediation required.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Trivy vulnerability scan completed. No high-risk vulnerabilities detected.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Anchore container analysis detected vulnerabilities that may pose unacceptable risk. AO review required.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Anchore container analysis completed. No high-risk vulnerabilities detected.

V-222513.title: The application must have the capability to prevent the installation of patches, service packs, or application components without verification the software component has been digitally signed.
V-222513.default_evidence: Review package installation and update mechanisms for signature verification.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Grype detected vulnerable packages that may lack signature verification. Review package provenance.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: No unsigned/unpatched packages detected by Grype. Manual review of signature verification mechanisms still required.

V-222516.title: The application must prevent program execution in accordance with organization-defined policies.
V-222516.default_evidence: Review application execution policies and runtime restrictions.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis detected policy violations affecting program execution controls.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis completed. Manual review of program execution policies still required.

V-222510.title: The application must prohibit user installation of software without explicit privileged status.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis detected configurations that may allow unprivileged software installation.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Checkov IaC analysis completed. No unauthorized software installation vectors detected.

V-222423.title: Application data protection requirements must be identified and documented.
V-222423.default_evidence: Review application documentation to confirm data protection requirements are identified and documented.

V-222486.title: The application must shut down by default upon audit failure.
V-222486.default_evidence: Review application error handling and shutdown behavior on audit failure.

V-222446.title: The application must record a time stamp indicating when the event occurred.
V-222446.default_evidence: Review application logging to confirm timestamps are recorded for all events.

V-222618.title: Unsigned Category 1A mobile code must not be used.
V-222618.default_evidence: Review application for use of mobile code.

tool_mappings.on_finding_evidence: Checkov detected unsigned or unverified code execution configurations.
tool_mappings.on_clean_evidence: Checkov analysis completed. Manual review for mobile code usage still required.
